newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-MANJREKAR REPLACES SIDHU IN INDIAN SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-MANJREKAR REPLACES SIDHU IN INDIAN SQUAD.

text.p: India recalled middle-order batsman Sanjay Manjrekar on Monday to replace the injured Navjot Sidhu in their squad for the Titan Cup final, Indian cricket officials said.
Sidhu injured his elbow while batting against Australia in the last round-robin limited overs match of the triangular tournament on Sunday.
India play South Africa in the final at Bombay's Wankhede Stadium on Wednesday.
